description.value: Sandy Bay B&B is a small waterfront bed and breakfast on Saturna Island with two rooms featuring ensuite bathrooms, separate entrances, and a private dining and sitting area overlooking a quiet sandy beach. Room #2 includes an adjoining room for families or larger groups. Saturna Island is promoted by its own tourism association as a cycling destination with peaceful, low-traffic roads — making this property a natural base for cycle touring in the Southern Gulf Islands.
